description: Alias for save_preview. Save a JPEG preview of a view and return the file path.

crop.description: Region [x0, y0, x1, y1] of the view in pixels (x1, y1 exclusive); the whole view when omitted

downsample.description: Divide width and height by this factor (>= 1). Omitted: the preview is scaled down to at most 2048 px on its longer side

stf_c0.description: Shadows clipping point of the linked STF given with stf_m (0 <= c0 < 1)

stf_from.description: Bake this view's STF (its display stretch) into the JPEG; the view may be view_id itself. Several previews given the same stf_from are stretched identically

stf_m.description: Bake a linked STF with this midtones balance (0 < m < 1) into the JPEG; needs stf_c0

name: save_and_show_preview
